python
import modal
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile
import subprocess
import os
import requests
from tqdm import tqdm

app = modal.App("alphafold3-production-b200")
cuda_version = "12.4.0"
flavor = "devel"
operating_sys = "ubuntu22.04"
tag = f"{cuda_version}-{flavor}-{operating_sys}"

image = (
    modal.Image.from_registry(f"nvidia/cuda:{tag}", add_python="3.11")
    .apt_install("wget", "git", "build-essential", "cmake", "gfortran", "libopenblas-dev", "curl")
    .run_commands("wget -q https://julialang-s3.julialang.org/bin/linux/x64/1.10/julia-1.10.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz")
    .run_commands("tar -xzf julia-1.10.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && mv julia-1.10.0 /opt/julia && rm julia-1.10.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz")
    .env({"PATH": "/opt/julia/bin:$PATH", "JULIA_NUM_THREADS": "96", "JULIA_DEPOT_PATH": "/opt/julia_depot"})
    .run_commands("mkdir -p /opt/julia_depot")
    .run_commands("julia -e 'using Pkg; packages = [\"CUDA\",\"Flux\",\"Zygote\",\"LinearAlgebra\",\"Statistics\",\"Random\",\"Printf\",\"JSON3\",\"Downloads\",\"Dates\",\"Distributed\",\"ProgressMeter\",\"DataFrames\",\"CSV\",\"ArgParse\",\"Clustering\",\"Optim\",\"Distributions\",\"StatsBase\",\"Distances\",\"NearestNeighbors\",\"BSON\",\"HTTP\",\"Tar\",\"CodecZlib\",\"UUIDs\",\"SIMD\",\"BenchmarkTools\",\"ThreadsX\",\"Enzyme\",\"GZip\",\"FilePaths\",\"NPZ\",\"JSON\",\"Parameters\",\"Requires\"]; for p in packages; try Pkg.add(p); catch; end; end'")
    .pip_install("requests", "tqdm", "numpy", "pandas", "biopython")
)

datasets_volume = modal.Volume.from_name("af3-datasets-b200", create_if_missing=True)
checkpoints_volume = modal.Volume.from_name("af3-checkpoints-b200", create_if_missing=True)

ALPHAFOLD_DATASETS = [
    "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/alphafold/latest/UP000000429_85962_HELPY_v6.tar",
    "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/alphafold/latest/UP000005640_9606_HUMAN_v6.tar",
    "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/alphafold/latest/swissprot_cif_v6.tar",
    "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/alphafold/latest/swissprot_pdb_v6.tar"
]

@app.function(
    image=image,
    gpu="B200:8",
    volumes={"/datasets": datasets_volume, "/checkpoints": checkpoints_volume},
    timeout=86400 * 7,
    memory=1024 * 1024,
    cpu=96.0,
)
def download_alphafold_datasets():
    print("=" * 100)
    print("📥 DOWNLOADING ALPHAFOLD DATASETS TO MODAL")
    print("=" * 100)
    print(f"Total datasets: {len(ALPHAFOLD_DATASETS)}")
    print("GPU: 8x NVIDIA B200")
    print("=" * 100)
    alphafold_dir = Path("/datasets/alphafold")
    alphafold_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    downloaded = 0
    failed = 0
    for url in tqdm(ALPHAFOLD_DATASETS, desc="Downloading AlphaFold datasets"):
        filename = url.split("/")[-1]
        filepath = alphafold_dir / filename
        if filepath.exists():
            print(f"✅ {filename} already exists")
            continue
        try:
            print(f"\n📦 Downloading {filename}...")
            response = requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=600)
            total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
            with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
                with tqdm(total=total_size, unit="iB", unit_scale=True, desc=filename) as pbar:
                    for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):
                        if chunk:
                            f.write(chunk)
                            pbar.update(len(chunk))
            print(f"📂 Extracting {filename}...")
            extract_dir = alphafold_dir / filename.replace(".tar", "")
            extract_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            with tarfile.open(filepath, "r:*") as tar:
                tar.extractall(path=extract_dir)
            filepath.unlink()
            downloaded += 1
            if downloaded % 5 == 0:
                datasets_volume.commit()
                print(f"💾 Checkpoint: {downloaded} datasets downloaded")
            print(f"✅ {filename} complete")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Failed {filename}: {str(e)}")
            failed += 1
        datasets_volume.commit()
    print("=" * 100)
    print("✅ ALPHAFOLD DATASETS DOWNLOAD COMPLETE")
    print(f" Downloaded: {downloaded}")
    print(f" Failed: {failed}")
    print(f" Total: {len(ALPHAFOLD_DATASETS)}")
    print("=" * 100)
    return {"downloaded": downloaded, "failed": failed, "total": len(ALPHAFOLD_DATASETS)}

@app.function(
    image=image,
    gpu="B200:8",
    volumes={"/datasets": datasets_volume, "/checkpoints": checkpoints_volume},
    timeout=86400 * 7,
    memory=1024 * 1024,
    cpu=96.0,
)
def train_alphafold3_b200(main_jl_content: str, epochs: int = 100, batch_size: int = 8, learning_rate: float = 0.0001):
    print("=" * 100)
    print("🧬 ALPHAFOLD3 PRODUCTION TRAINING ON 8x NVIDIA B200 GPUs")
    print("=" * 100)
    print(f"GPU: 8x NVIDIA B200 (192GB HBM3e each = 1.5TB total VRAM)")
    print(f"CPU: 96 cores")
    print(f"RAM: 1TB")
    print(f"Epochs: {epochs}")
    print(f"Batch Size: {batch_size}")
    print(f"Learning Rate: {learning_rate}")
    print("=" * 100)
    main_jl_path = Path("/tmp/main.jl")
    with open(main_jl_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(main_jl_content)
    file_size_mb = len(main_jl_content) / (1024 * 1024)
    line_count = main_jl_content.count("\n")
    print(f"✅ main.jl written: {file_size_mb:.2f} MB, {line_count:,} lines")
    print("🔧 Verifying CUDA on B200...")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["julia", "-e", "using CUDA; println(\"CUDA functional: \", CUDA.functional()); println(\"CUDA devices: \", length(CUDA.devices())); for i in 1:length(CUDA.devices()) println(\"GPU \", i, \": \", CUDA.name(CUDA.device(i-1))) end"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print("Stderr:", result.stderr)
    launcher_content = f"""
ENV["DATASET_PATH"] = "/datasets"
ENV["CHECKPOINT_DIR"] = "/checkpoints"
ENV["EPOCHS"] = "{epochs}"
ENV["BATCH_SIZE"] = "{batch_size}"
ENV["LEARNING_RATE"] = "{learning_rate}"
ENV["USE_GPU"] = "true"
ENV["JULIA_NUM_THREADS"] = "96"
println("=" ^ 100)
println("🚀 Loading AlphaFold3 main.jl (production code)...")
println("=" ^ 100)
include("/tmp/main.jl")
println("\n" * ("=" ^ 100))
println("🔥 STARTING ALPHAFOLD3 TRAINING ON 8x NVIDIA B200...")
println("=" ^ 100)
try
    run_training()
    println("\n" * ("=" ^ 100))
    println("✅ TRAINING COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!")
    println("=" ^ 100)
catch e
    println("\n" * ("=" ^ 100))
    println("❌ TRAINING ERROR:")
    println(e)
    println("=" ^ 100)
    rethrow(e)
end
"""
    launcher_path = Path("/tmp/train_launcher.jl")
    with open(launcher_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(launcher_content)
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        ["julia", "--project", str(launcher_path)],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
        bufsize=1,
    )
    for line in process.stdout:
        print(line, end="")
    return_code = process.wait()
    checkpoints_volume.commit()
    print("=" * 100)
    if return_code == 0:
        print("✅ ALPHAFOLD3 TRAINING COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!")
    else:
        print(f"❌ TRAINING FAILED WITH CODE: {return_code}")
    print("=" * 100)
    checkpoint_dir = Path("/checkpoints")
    checkpoints = list(checkpoint_dir.glob("*.bson"))
    print(f"💾 Saved {len(checkpoints)} checkpoints to Modal volume")
    return {
        "status": "completed" if return_code == 0 else "failed",
        "return_code": return_code,
        "epochs": epochs,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "learning_rate": learning_rate,
        "checkpoints": len(checkpoints),
        "gpu": "8x NVIDIA B200",
    }

@app.local_entrypoint()
def main(action: str = "train", epochs: int = 100, batch_size: int = 8, learning_rate: float = 0.0001):
    print("=" * 100)
    print("🧬 ALPHAFOLD3 MODAL B200 PRODUCTION TRAINING SYSTEM")
    print("=" * 100)
    print(f"Action: {action}")
    print(f"GPU: 8x NVIDIA B200 (1.5TB total VRAM)")
    print("=" * 100)
    if action == "download":
        print("📥 DOWNLOADING ALPHAFOLD DATASETS TO MODAL...")
        result = download_alphafold_datasets.remote()
        print("✅ DATASET DOWNLOAD RESULT:")
        print(result)
    elif action == "train":
        print("🚀 STARTING ALPHAFOLD3 TRAINING ON 8x B200...")
        main_jl_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "main.jl")
        if not os.path.exists(main_jl_path):
            print(f"❌ ERROR: main.jl not found at {main_jl_path}")
            return
        with open(main_jl_path, "r") as f:
            main_jl_content = f.read()
        result = train_alphafold3_b200.remote(main_jl_content=main_jl_content, epochs=epochs, batch_size=batch_size, learning_rate=learning_rate)
        print("✅ TRAINING RESULT:")
        print(result)
    elif action == "full":
        print("📥 PHASE 1: DOWNLOADING ALPHAFOLD DATASETS...")
        result1 = download_alphafold_datasets.remote()
        print(f"✅ Download result: {result1}")
        print("🚀 PHASE 2: STARTING TRAINING...")
        main_jl_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "main.jl")
        if not os.path.exists(main_jl_path):
            print(f"❌ ERROR: main.jl not found at {main_jl_path}")
            return
        with open(main_jl_path, "r") as f:
            main_jl_content = f.read()
        result2 = train_alphafold3_b200.remote(main_jl_content=main_jl_content, epochs=epochs, batch_size=batch_size, learning_rate=learning_rate)
        print("✅ FULL PIPELINE COMPLETED:")
        print(f" Download: {result1}")
        print(f" Training: {result2}")
    else:
        print(f"❌ Unknown action: {action}")
        print("Available actions:")
        print(" - download: Download AlphaFold datasets to Modal")
        print(" - train: Start training with 8x B200 (requires main.jl)")
        print(" - full: Download + train (complete pipeline)")
